title: Helping at a School Reading Day
context: 家长 Emily 和老师 Ben 商量阅读日的志愿工作与接送信息。 本课为 2026-11-22 预制系列原创练习，并非真实考试题。

dialogue.speaker: Emily
dialogue.en: I saw the note about reading day. Could I help at the event?
dialogue.zh: 我看到阅读日的通知了。我能在活动中帮忙吗？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: We would appreciate that. Can you help children find their reading groups?
dialogue.zh: 非常感谢。你能帮孩子们找到各自的阅读小组吗？

dialogue.speaker: Emily
dialogue.en: Yes. Where should I meet them?

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Please meet them at the classroom door after lunch.
dialogue.zh: 请午饭后在教室门口接他们。

dialogue.speaker: Emily
dialogue.en: Will there be a list of the groups?

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Yes, I will give you one with the room names.
dialogue.zh: 会的，我会给你一份写有教室名称的名单。

dialogue.speaker: Emily
dialogue.en: My son is in your class. May I bring him home afterward?
dialogue.zh: 我儿子在您的班上。活动结束后我可以带他回家吗？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Yes. Please let me know before you leave with him.
dialogue.zh: 可以。带他离开前请告诉我一声。

dialogue.speaker: Emily
dialogue.en: Of course. Do you need me to bring any books?

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: No, the school has prepared enough for this event.
dialogue.zh: 不用，学校为这次活动准备了足够的书。

dialogue.speaker: Emily
dialogue.en: Then I will come a little early to look at the list.
dialogue.zh: 那我会早点来看看名单。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Thank you, Emily. I will see you at the classroom door.

expressions.example: My sister helped at the school concert.
Our reading group meets on Friday.

expressions.zh: 之后，指前面提到的事情结束后。
expressions.example: We watched a play and talked afterward.
Please let me know when you arrive.
I arrived a little early to find my seat.

pronunciation: classroom 重音在第一音节；在 let me 中，两个词连贯但仍保留 /t/ 的收尾。

practice.title: Part 1 · School events
practice.prompt: Did you enjoy school events as a child?
practice.answer: Yes. I liked reading days because we could listen to stories with children from other classes.

practice.title: Part 2 · A school activity
practice.prompt: Describe a school activity you helped with or attended. Say what happened, who was there, and how you felt.
practice.answer: I helped at a reading day at my son's school. After lunch, I met a group of children at their classroom door and helped them find the right room. The teacher gave me a list, so I could check where everyone needed to go. I enjoyed listening to the children talk about their books. At the end, I told the teacher before taking my son home. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · School and families
practice.prompt: How can schools make it easier for families to join events?
practice.answer: Schools can give clear information in advance and offer different ways to help. Short tasks and accessible times may allow more families to take part.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 跟读询问志愿任务的对话，再确认地点和需要携带的物品。
practice.answer: Could I help at reading day? Where should I meet the children? Please let me know if I need to bring anything.
